name: Kilburn Engineering Ltd
title: Kilburn Engineering Ltd - 522101 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 consol EBITDA 22.95% on INR189 cr revenue; order intake shifted a quarter with FY27 INR800-1,000 cr target, but receivables and working capital days rose from 169 to 184, weakening cash conversion.

capex.quote: It remains the same what we've been guiding for in the last 2, 3 calls, which is around 40 crores odd.

triggers.label: Working capital days 169 → 184
triggers.quote: in this FY26, our working capital days went from 169 to 184 days

triggers.label: Order intake shifted a quarter
triggers.quote: We have witnessed a shift by a quarter in closing some of our major orders.

triggers.label: FY27 order intake INR800-1,000 cr
triggers.quote: we are targeting an order intake of around INR800 crores to INR1,000 crores at group level

triggers.label: Expansion done by Sept-Oct 2026
triggers.quote: We believe this will be completed by September, October of this year.

triggers.label: No cost pass-through
triggers.quote: So, we don't have a pass-through.

guidance.quote: We have set a growth target of 20% to 25% on top line over last year, which would result in a revenue of around INR750 crores to INR800 crores.
we are targeting an order intake of around INR800 crores to INR1,000 crores at group level
We hope to continue EBITDA margins of 20% plus.
It remains the same what we've been guiding for in the last 2, 3 calls, which is around 40 crores odd.

themes: Waste heat recovery in steel and ferrous alloy

red_flags.label: Working capital days 169 to 184; receivables up ~INR100 cr
red_flags.quote: in this FY26, our working capital days went from 169 to 184 days

red_flags.label: Standalone operating cash flow negative, worsened INR9 cr to INR17 cr
red_flags.quote: our cash flow negative went from INR9 crores to INR17 crores

red_flags.label: Order intake shift, opening book lower than last year
red_flags.quote: I do agree with you that today, the opening order is on the lower side compared to last year.

red_flags.label: Investor deck growth CAGR typo, not clarified in deck
red_flags.quote: I think it's a typo error by the IR team who's made it.

evasions.quote: We are not giving that breakup because we have mentioned in the past as well
We have not missed orders. We have just mentioned that certain orders getting finalized have got shifted
it depends on product mix, also the type of orders we are executing.
